verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev exposes an MCP server so external AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) can control Trigger.dev projects, and supports building durable AI chat agents as tasks — but there is no evidence of a built-in AI assistant inside the Trigger.dev product/dashboard that a user delegates tasks to; the relationship is the reverse (Trigger.dev is a tool other assistants call into).
